ValidationRule.description: As Part of the IP Repat Project, Legal Entity must be Tanium Inc., Tanium UK or Tanium Federal Corporation. Only Admins can change this.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Legal_Entity__c ) , Legal_Entity__r.Name <> "Tanium UK Limited", Legal_Entity__r.Name <> "Tanium Inc.", Legal_Entity__r.Name <> "Tanium Federal Corporation", Legal_Entity__r.Name != 'Tanium Federal LLC', $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "Tanium System Administrator" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Legal Entity must be Tanium Inc., Tanium UK or Tanium Federal Corporation.
